entities.summary: Abraham Boualo Kome, is a Cameroonian Roman Catholic prelate who is the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bafang, Cameroon since 2012. He was appointed bishop by Pope Benedict XVI on 26 May 2012. He was consecrated and installed there on 15 July 2012. He concurrently served as Apostolic Administrator of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bafia, Cameroon from 6 June 2017 until 11 July 2020.
